newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian state to sell shares in housing firms.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian state to sell shares in housing firms.

text.p: The Egyptian state will sell off through the stock exchange all or some of its shares in four housing companies, the newspaper al-Akhbar said on Monday.
The companies are Cairo Housing and Development, Development and Popular Houses, Nasr Housing and Construction and Maamoura Housing and Development, it said.
The government newspaper quoted Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid, speaking after a meeting of shareholders of the state's Holding Company for Housing, Tourism and Cinema.
The holding company has already privatised more than 65 percent of Cairo Housing and Development but the other three companies remain fully state-owned.

The newspaper said there would no upper limit on the proportion of its shares the holding company would sell. But it gave no timetable and did not mention any share prices. Holding company officials were not available.
